mechanism: NSAIDs reduce renal blood flow and inhibit prostaglandin-mediated sodium excretion, increasing hyperkalemia risk in patients on aldosterone antagonists; concurrent use also increases renal dysfunction and acute kidney injury risk.
action: Avoid this combination if possible; if necessary, monitor serum potassium and renal function closely, ensure adequate hydration, and consider alternative analgesics or use lowest effective NSAID dose with careful monitoring.
